label: Caregivers researching CAR-T for lupus
description: Caregivers / loved-ones in lupus-CAR-T discussions. In this corpus they show up as community RESEARCHERS more than emotional supporters — surfacing specific trial sponsors (Fate Therapeutics, BMS), NCT registry links, outcome measures (fatigue scores, hospitalization length), comparing chemo regimens across studies. Also includes caregivers narrating their loved-one's lived CAR-T experience (CRS, ICANS, post-infusion proximity requirements). High signal-to-noise ratio for trial-design intel.
